Order Appendix Forms TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Indian Tolls Act, 1851 Show all section Section 1. [Repealed.]. Section 1A. Extent. Section 2. Power to cause levy of tolls on roads and bridges within certain rates, and to appoint collectors. Section 3. Their powers for recovery of toll. Section 4. Exemptions from payment of toll. Section 5. Assistance of collectors by Police-officers. Section 6. Penalty for offences under Act. Compensation to person aggrieved. Saving of his right to sue. Section 7. Exhibition of table of tolls, and statement of penalties. Section 8. Application of proceeds of tolls. Schedule 1. SCHEDULE.
